title: 2.12 In the Classroom
unit_title: Unit 2: Places, Things, Numbers and Colors
unit_outcome: Name places and things with un/una and el/la, count them, and say their color and size with the right ending.
goal: Name classroom things and ask a choice question with o; a role has no article: Ella es estudiante.
grammar_function: ¿Es un X o un Y? Es un/una + noun; Ella es + role (no article).
speaking_outcome: Name and ask about classroom things.
